patthana15.59:1.1: sappītikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappītiko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: appītikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appītiko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.59:2.1: sappītikaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappītiko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: appītikaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appītiko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇiyeva. pītisagagataduka kusalattike napītisahagataduka nakusalattikaṃ
